about: Osc A of the Audio Unit at one voice, Rand Phase 0, on tables of ours, A Warp Mode (its index floor(70 v): Bend + 2, Bend - 3, Bend +/- 4, PWM 5) and A Warp. curves: {mode, warp, points: [φ, w]} the warped phase w of 64 samples of a cycle of C0 at the phase φ of the unwarped note (w = atan2 of a sine and a cosine render / 2π). spectra: {table, mode, warp, harmonics, dc} the harmonics 1..40 of the saw (scripts/bench-osc/sound.mjs), the sine and the cosine at C0, dB against the fundamental unwarped (null: under -140 dB), dc the mean of 4 cycles from sample 6000 against that fundamental. aliasing: {note, mode, warp, aliasing, spur} the saw at C6 and C7 at 48 kHz, analyze of the oscillator benchmark (as aliasing.json). moving: Bend + at C0 with A Warp automated from 0 at 0.1 s to 1 at 0.4 s, set every sample: `knob` [sample, knob] the knob the map of a sample tells (every 16th, where |2φ - 1| is within 0.2..0.9: it moves every sample), `tau` the time constant (ms) of the one-pole it follows the automation through (the one-pole of the knob and its routes in the core, warp::SMOOTHING, is 11.3 ms: an LFO on the knob, 0.5 to 100 Hz at D2 and D4, follows one of 11.3 ms and no delay in every mode, its renders against those of the core at 11.3 and 10.5 ms). notes: {table, note, mode, warp, harmonics} the saw and the ramp (the saw from 0 up, its jump in the middle: frame 0 of Default Shapes) at D2 and D4 by Bend - and Bend +/-, the harmonics to 16 kHz as spectra, dB against the fundamental of the note unwarped. scripts/renders/run.mjs --only=warp [--parts=curves,spectra,aliasing,moving,notes]
